assessment: In regard to subpopulations of memory Tfh cells, the authors nicely showed the significance of Tfh17 cells. Although some concerns about their functional advantages relative to other Tfh subpopulations, Tfh1 and Tfh2, were raised by the reviewers, the authors nicely responded to their concerns. This study contributes to understanding the heterogeneity of memory Tfh cells and provides clues for better vaccine designs.
